tasks.question: How does Sphinx's parallel build system handle exception propagation from worker processes back to the main process while preserving meaningful traceback information?
tasks.reference_answer: ParallelTasks._process catches BaseException, formats its message and full traceback, and sends those strings plus collected logs through a pipe (sphinx/util/parallel.py:69-83). _join_one raises SphinxParallelError from the received pair when failed; only successful results reach the subsequent log-replay loop (lines121-130). The wrapper stores message/traceback (sphinx/errors.py:104-114), and CLI reporting or saved tracebacks use that worker traceback rather than only the parent stack (sphinx/cmd/build.py:52-58; sphinx/util/exceptions.py:25-28). Thus traceback preservation is supported, but replay of logs from a failing worker is not guaranteed by this path.
